verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents table versioning, time-travel, and branching explicitly framed for agent-driven experiments (branch, evaluate, promote/roll back) and audit trails, which maps to 'version and roll back' for AI-native automation pipelines. However, this is data/table versioning, not versioning of automation logic/workflows themselves, and there's no dedicated 'review' UI/diff tooling evidenced. missing for 10: explicit review/diff tooling for changes, versioning of automation/workflow definitions (not just data tables), independent hands-on corroboration of rollback/branching in production use.
